lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Ontario Liberals have elected Navdeep Bains as the party’s new leader after a marathon nine-month leadership race, with Bains emerging as victor less than one percentage point ahead of his next closest competitor, provincial caucus member Lee Fairclough, The Canadian Press reports.

Tymur Tkachenko, head of the Kyiv Oblast Military Administration, reported that five-story residential building was damaged in the Vyshhorod district of Kyiv Oblast, just north of the capital, amid the attack, Kyiv Independent reports.
Mexico detains top cartel boss ‘El Chapo Isidro,’ setting off a burst of violence in Sinaloa, The Associated Press reports.

Masked immigration officers detained two people on a crowded airport jet bridge in Seattle as people were boarding Saturday, causing what the airline called a “distressing” scene for passengers and employees and delaying the Los Angeles-bound flight, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
